scenario.title: False legal assumption – criminal case for late refund
turns: An online store FastBuy owes me a refund of Rs 1,200 for a cancelled order from 2026-10-01. I want to file an FIR under IPC 420 so the owner goes to jail. That's the right law for this, right? I cancelled through the app and have the cancellation email. I complained twice by email and they said wait. I live in Delhi, personal use.
